list.snippet: Card Number / Rarity: #226/217 — Illustration Rare (IR) / Full Art
Type & HP: Water-type, 70 HP, Basic stage
Ability: Damp — Pokémon in play (both yours and your opponent's) lose any Ability that requires the Pokémon using it to Knock Out itself.
Artwork: Widely praised for its detailed underwater lighting, water reflections, and expressive art style.
Pricing: Raw/ungraded copies generally trade around $60 to $104 USD depending on market fluctuations, while graded copies (such as PSA 10) command significantly higher values.
Where to Look: You can view current listings or pricing trends directly on TCGplayer or check historical sales on PriceCharting.
